# truenas_static_route (Resource)

Create a Static Route.

Address families of `gateway` and `destination` should match when creating a static route.

`description` is an optional attribute for any notes regarding the static route.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination network or host for this static route.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP address for this static route.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description for this static route. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_static_route.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_static_route.example 1
```
